hardware: HKU GPU Farm · NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER · PyTorch 2.0.1+cu118

tldr.zh: 六组对照分别检查轴的含义、共享目标、更新尺度、模型容量、梯度传播和融合时保留的信息。小样本实验中，扩大模型提高了测试准确率，组合正则降低了测试 loss；这两项结果来自不同配置。
tldr.en: The six comparisons examine axis conventions, shared objectives, update scale, model capacity, gradient propagation, and the information retained during fusion. In the small-data experiment, widening improves test accuracy, while combined regularization lowers test loss; those results come from different settings.

title.en: 1. The shape fits. The axes do not.

setup.zh: 张量能传进下一个模块时，每个元素还在预期的位置吗？我用一个位置分类器检查这个问题：输入有 batch、time、channel 三根轴，上下游对后两根轴的约定相反。我先训练并冻结分类器，再分别用 permute 和 reshape 接入输入。前者交换轴，后者重新分组元素，两者的输出形状相同。为了区分接口问题与学习能力，我还做了逆映射恢复和从头训练两个对照。
setup.en: When a tensor fits the next module, are its entries still where that module expects them? I use a position classifier to check this. The input has batch, time, and channel axes, and the upstream and downstream conventions swap the last two. After training and freezing the classifier, I connect the input using either permute or reshape. One exchanges axes; the other regroups entries. Both produce the same shape. I also restore the mapping and train from scratch to distinguish an interface mismatch from a limitation in what the classifier can learn.

takeaway.zh: 在这个例子里，固定排列仍然可以学会，但冻结模型依赖训练时的轴约定。带编号的张量让我能直接看出接口改变了哪些位置；只看输出 shape 会漏掉这一点。
takeaway.en: The fixed permutation remains learnable in this example, while the frozen model depends on the axis convention used in training. Numbering the entries makes the changed positions visible; the output shape alone leaves that mismatch hidden.

columns.zh: 测试准确率 · 均值 [范围]

rows.zh: 错误布局 · 从头训练

observation.zh: 错误 reshape 后，冻结模型的准确率从 98.5% 降到 50.2%，恢复映射后准确率也恢复了。接着看从头训练的对照：同样的错误布局达到了 98.5%。这两个对照让我把性能下降定位到接口与已学位置约定的错配；分类器仍然能从头学习这个固定排列。
observation.en: With the wrong reshape, the frozen classifier’s accuracy falls from 98.5% to 50.2%. Restoring the mapping restores its accuracy. The from-scratch control then reaches 98.5% with the same wrong layout. Together, these controls point to a mismatch with the position convention already learned by the frozen classifier. The classifier can still learn that fixed permutation from scratch.

title.zh: 2. 两个 loss，在争同一个位置

setup.zh: 加入辅助任务后，如果主任务变差，是辅助梯度的影响，还是共享表示装不下两种信息？我用两个独立信号 s 和 n 来拆开这两个因素：主任务预测 s，辅助任务重建 n，两者尺度一致。共享层与输出头都为线性，共享表示先限制为一维。我改变辅助权重 λ，再分别让辅助梯度不进入共享层（detach）、把表示扩到二维。
setup.en: If an auxiliary task hurts the main task, is the issue its gradient or the amount of information the shared representation can hold? I use independent signals s and n to separate these factors. The main task predicts s; the auxiliary task reconstructs n, with matched target scales. The shared layer and both heads are linear, and the representation starts with one coordinate. I vary the auxiliary weight λ, then separately detach its gradient from the shared layer and expand the representation to two coordinates.

takeaway.zh: detach 与扩宽表示回答了不同的问题：前者阻断了辅助目标对共享层的梯度影响，后者给两个独立信号各留了一个方向。在这个线性案例里，共享表示的容量限制帮助解释了两项误差为什么此消彼长。
takeaway.en: Detaching and widening answer different questions: one blocks the auxiliary gradient from reaching the shared layer; the other gives each independent signal a direction of its own. In this linear case, the representation’s capacity helps explain the trade-off between the two errors.

results.title: Two useful tasks can compete for one coordinate

observation.zh: λ=4 时，辅助任务误差很低，主任务 MSE 为 1.013，接近预测均值的水平。detach 后主任务误差恢复到很低的水平，但辅助误差仍然较高；扩到二维后，两项误差同时下降。因此，辅助权重改变了这一维表示偏向哪个目标，而扩宽表示让两个信号都能保留下来。λ=0 的辅助头未训练，表中留空。
observation.en: At λ=4, the auxiliary error is small and main-task MSE is 1.013, close to a mean predictor. Detaching brings the main-task error back down, while auxiliary error stays high. With two coordinates, both errors fall. The auxiliary weight therefore changes which target the one-dimensional representation favors; widening allows both signals to be retained. The λ=0 auxiliary head is untrained, so its table entry is blank.

title.zh: 3. 模块没变大，更新却变猛了
title.en: 3. A small branch can make a large update

setup.zh: 同一个分支，只改变输出尺度，原来的学习率还适用吗？我让新分支拟合一个残差：目标是 x₀ + aᵀx，预测是 x₀ + g·wᵀx，其中 x 有 16 维、a 固定，w 从零开始。把增益 g 从 1 改成 8，平方误差对 w 的曲率就增加到 64 倍。因此我比较保留原 SGD 学习率、LR 除以 64、仅 warmup 和仅梯度裁剪四种处理。
setup.en: Does the original learning rate still work if I change only a branch’s output scale? The branch fits a residual: the target is x₀ + aᵀx and the prediction is x₀ + g·wᵀx, with 16-dimensional x, fixed a, and w initialized to zero. Increasing the gain g from 1 to 8 multiplies the squared-loss curvature in w by 64. This gives a concrete comparison: keep the original SGD rate, divide it by 64, add warmup alone, or add gradient clipping alone.

takeaway.zh: 这里参数数量没有变化，稳定的 SGD 步长却随增益改变。warmup 延后了触发停止的时间，clipping 限制了梯度，但这两个设置都没有达到缩小 LR 的最终误差。这个比例关系来自当前平方误差模型与 SGD；换成 Adam，需要另做对照。
takeaway.en: The parameter count stays fixed, but the stable SGD step changes with the gain. Warmup delays the stop threshold and clipping limits the gradient, yet neither setting reaches the final error of the smaller learning rate. The scaling relation comes from this squared-loss model with SGD; Adam would need a separate comparison.

columns.zh: 测试 MSE · 最后记录

results.title: Changing branch gain changes the stable SGD step

observation.zh: g=8 保留原学习率时，第 4 步触发了训练 MSE > 10⁸ 的停止阈值。加 warmup 后，触发时间延到第 17 步；当时 warmup 尚未结束，LR 已升到 0.0408，超过这个问题的稳定范围。相比之下，LR 除以 64 后，loss 轨迹与 g=1 相同。clipping 完成了 240 步，最终测试 MSE 为 0.444。图中默认使用对数轴，方便同时看发散与稳定的曲线。
observation.en: With g=8 and the original learning rate, training MSE crosses the 10⁸ stop threshold at step 4. Warmup delays this to step 17. At that point warmup is still running, but LR has reached 0.0408, above the stability range for this problem. Dividing LR by 64 instead matches the g=1 loss trajectory. Clipping completes all 240 steps, with final test MSE of 0.444. The plot starts on a log scale so both divergent and stable curves are visible.

title.zh: 4. 拟合得更好，学到的是哪部分？

setup.zh: 我想看，在少量带错标的训练数据上，扩大模型会怎样改变训练与测试表现。我用 sklearn 的手写数字数据，在训练标签中固定加入 20% 噪声，测试标签保持干净。先比较同样 100 张训练图像上的小 MLP、宽 MLP，以及加入 dropout 和 weight decay 的宽 MLP；再把宽模型的训练样本增加到 500 张。这样可以分别观察模型宽度、组合正则和样本量的变化。
setup.en: I want to see how a wider model changes training and test performance when the training set is small and contains wrong labels. I use sklearn’s handwritten digits, fix 20% label noise in training, and keep test labels clean. First I compare a small MLP, a wide MLP, and a wide MLP with dropout and weight decay on the same 100 training images. I then give the wide model 500 images. These comparisons let me look separately at width, the combined regularization setting, and sample count.

takeaway.zh: 小模型和宽模型都记住了这 100 张图像的训练标签，其中包括错标。干净测试集上的两个指标却给出不同排序：宽模型分类更准，正则后的宽模型 cross-entropy 更低。因此，这组结果需要分别从分类正确率和预测概率来理解。
takeaway.en: Both the small and wide models fit all 100 training labels, including the wrong ones. On the clean test set, the two metrics give different rankings: the wide model classifies more images correctly, while the regularized wide model has lower cross-entropy. I therefore read classification accuracy and the assigned probabilities as two parts of this result.

columns.zh: 训练准确率 · 含错标
测试准确率 · 干净标签

rows.zh: 宽模型 + 正则 · 100 张

results.title: More parameters with the same noisy labels

observation.zh: 扩大模型后的变化需要分开看：测试准确率从 63.3% 升到 67.6%，cross-entropy 也升高了。加入组合正则后，loss 降到 1.199，准确率为 65.8%。因此，准确率与 loss 给出了不同排序。把训练样本增加到 500 张后，准确率达到 76.6%；这一对照每步也处理了 5 倍的数据量。这里记录的是 dropout 与 weight decay 的共同效果。
observation.en: Widening changes the two test metrics in different ways: accuracy rises from 63.3% to 67.6%, and cross-entropy also rises. With the combined regularization setting, loss falls to 1.199 and accuracy is 65.8%. Accuracy and loss therefore rank these models differently. Increasing the training set to 500 images gives 76.6% accuracy, while also processing five times as many images per update. The regularized result measures dropout and weight decay together.

title.zh: 5. 前面的层，真的收到信号了吗？
title.en: 5. Did the early layers get a signal?

setup.zh: 网络加深后，梯度传到前面还剩多少？我搭了一条带收缩初始化的 tanh 网络，比较 2 层和 20 层，再加入残差、LayerNorm，以及两者组合。先测初始化时逐层的激活与梯度 RMS，再用相同更新次数做短训练。我关心的是：梯度沿层传播的变化，是否与训练后的误差对应。这里的收缩初始化是为了把这一现象放大到可观察的程度。
setup.en: How much gradient reaches the early layers as the network gets deeper? I build a tanh network with contractive initialization and compare depths of 2 and 20, then add residual connections, LayerNorm, or both. I measure layerwise activation and gradient RMS at initialization, followed by short training with the same number of updates. I want to compare the gradient profile with the final error. The contractive initialization makes this effect easier to observe.

takeaway.zh: 在这条收缩网络里，plain 版本前端的激活梯度很小，训练后误差也较高。残差和 LayerNorm 都改变了梯度分布并降低了误差，但初始梯度最大或同时加上两者的版本，并没有取得最低误差。逐层梯度提供了诊断线索，最终训练表现还需要一起看。
takeaway.en: In this contracting network, the plain version has very small activation gradients near the input and a higher final error. Residual connections and LayerNorm both change the gradient profile and reduce error. However, neither the largest initial gradient nor the combination of both interventions gives the lowest error. The layerwise gradients offer a diagnostic clue alongside the training outcome.

results.title: Following gradients through a contracting stack

observation.zh: 20 层 plain 网络的最终测试 MSE 为 0.976，单加残差后为 4.41e-04。LayerNorm 也降低了误差，两者组合的误差仍高于单加残差。为了看信号如何传到前面的层，我记录的是激活梯度 ∂L/∂h；h₀ 是输入投影后的隐状态。下面的梯度图按前向层位置排列，反传方向从右往左，可以与后面的训练曲线一起看。
observation.en: The 20-layer plain network ends at test MSE 0.976; adding residual connections gives 4.41e-04. LayerNorm also lowers error, while the combined setting has higher error than residual connections alone. To follow the signal reaching earlier layers, I record activation gradients ∂L/∂h, with h₀ denoting the hidden state after the input projection. The gradient plot follows forward layer positions, so backpropagation runs right to left. It can be read alongside the training curves below.

title.zh: 6. 是融合太晚，还是信息已经没了？
title.en: 6. Too late to fuse, or too little left?

setup.zh: 融合位置的变化，可能也改变了送进 head 的信息。我用两路平衡的 ±1 序列检查这一点：第二路等于第一路，或者正好相反，任务是区分这两种关系。两路各自的均值都是 0，因此我比较逐位置融合后取平均、各自取平均后融合。再分别扩宽晚融合 head、补入交叉统计量 mean(x·z)，看容量和输入信息的变化各有什么影响。
setup.en: Changing the fusion point may also change what information reaches the head. I check this with two balanced ±1 streams: the second equals the first or its negative, and the task is to distinguish the two relationships. Both streams have mean zero. I compare position-wise fusion before averaging with separate averaging before fusion, then separately widen the late-fusion head and add the cross-statistic mean(x·z). This separates a change in head capacity from a change in its input information.

takeaway.zh: 在这个任务里，分别取平均把两种关系都变成了 (0, 0)，扩宽 head 后输入仍然相同。补入平均乘积后，两类重新可以区分。这让我把融合顺序的问题具体化为：汇总之后，任务所需的关系还在不在？
takeaway.en: For this task, separate averaging turns both relationships into (0, 0); widening the head leaves those inputs identical. Adding the mean product makes the classes distinguishable again. This gives me a more concrete question about fusion order: does the summary retain the relationship the task asks for?

columns.zh: 测试准确率 · 均值 [范围]

rows.zh: 各自平均 → 更宽的 head

results.title: Averaging first removes the alignment signal

observation.zh: 分别取平均后的两个版本都是 50%，逐位置融合和补入交叉统计量都是 100%。扩宽 head 没有改变结果，补入关系信息后结果才改变，和上面的均值计算一致。这是一个简单的区分任务：每类内部的序列有相同的 token-pair 直方图，两类之间不同。逐位置 head 可以学习这个差别，但也需要在 8 个位置分别运行，因此计算量与晚融合版本不同。
observation.en: Both separate-mean variants score 50%; position-wise fusion and the cross-statistic control score 100%. Widening the head leaves the result unchanged, while supplying the relationship changes it, consistent with the mean calculation above. The classification task is simple: sequences within a class share a token-pair histogram, and the histograms differ between classes. The position-wise head can learn this distinction, but it also runs at eight positions, so its compute differs from the late-fusion version.
